method.cost: mean absolute RGB channel difference in 0..255 units where both alpha==255; zero otherwise
method.dp: minimum accumulated cost, predecessor offsets -1, 0, +1; deterministic first-min tie break
method.directions: vertical left/right; horizontal top; diagonal square chooses lower path-mean orientation
method.corner_resolution: when overlap candidates cover the same corner pixels, lowest path mean supplies the cut; first candidate wins exact ties
method.feather: linear new-side weight from 0 to 1 over signed path offset -3 to +3 pixels
method.exclusive_support: only source with alpha>0 wins regardless of seam weight
method.compositing: premultiplied weighted interpolation, then straight-alpha RGB output
method.statistics: path mean and p95 include zero-cost non-jointly-opaque samples; opaque-only quantities recorded separately
method.existing: cost is against composite already placed; geometric chunk pair and composite provenance reported
